actions.addContactToCampaign.description: Add a single contact to a campaign
actions.addContactToCampaign.props.campa: The unique identifier of the campaign
actions.addContactToCampaign.props.first: The first name of the contact (max 150 characters)
actions.addContactToCampaign.props.lastn: The last name of the contact (max 150 characters)
actions.addContactToCampaign.props.login: The login URL for the contact
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make custom API calls to Let's Calendar. Note: An access token must first be generated using your client key and secret key via the /access_token endpoint. This access token is then used to authenticate all subsequent API requests by adding it to the Authorization header as 'Bearer ${accessToken}'.
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
